title: Urban Camping Gear Axe Metal Small
description:
The ‘Camping Gear’ themed assets focus on practical outdoor equipment and well-used travel supplies designed for temporary campsites and wilderness setups. Featuring high-fidelity scans of sleeping gear, backpacks, cooking equipment, storage containers, and miscellaneous campsite props, this collection captures the functional, lived-in character of outdoor exploration and survival.

Ideal for creating grounded campsite environments with a strong sense of realism, utility, and environmental storytelling.
